chunks: And those who are watchful of their acts of prayer.

key_terms.صَلَوَاتِهِمْ: their prayers (plural of salat, indicating multiple or habitual prayers)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be watchful of one's prayers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to encompass both the five obligatory prayers and the Sunnah prayers, with some scholars emphasizing the preservation of prayer times and the quality of concentration (khushu). It serves as a defining trait of the true believers (al-mu'minun), linking ritual fidelity directly to spiritual success and divine mercy in the Hereafter.
